weather: Stormy morning, river low by midday
update: Much better than expected. Bumpy but easily passable at about 50 km/h most of the way, even in a small 4x4 (RAV4). Watch out for sudden patches of corrugation: hit them too fast and you could damage your car. A new bridge is under construction, so traffic uses the old low-water crossing next to it. The river was very low, so no problem crossing. It will probably be graded once the bridge is finished.
